## ARTEX - Vue d'ensemble
Activite liee a ARTEX (plateforme de pentest autonome) vue dans vos logs web, DNS et EDR. Les IP de la watchlist **ArtexAllowlist** sont exclues. Playbook : `playbook/PLAYBOOK.md` du depot.

content.query:
ArtexWebRequests
| where SrcIp !in (ArtexAllowlist)
| extend Category = case(
    UserAgent startswith "ARTEX-Assessment/", "UA ARTEX-Assessment",
    Target matches regex @"(?i)sess_[a-z0-9,-]{6,}", "php2shell",
    Target matches regex @"(?i)(\.\./){3,}|/etc/passwd|php://(filter|input)|data://text/plain|expect://", "LFI",
    Target matches regex @"(?i)union(\s|\+)+(all(\s|\+)+)?select|sleep\(\d+\)|waitfor(\s|\+)+delay|extractvalue\(|updatexml\(", "SQLi",
    Target matches regex @"(?i)<script|onerror\s*=|javascript:alert|<svg", "XSS",
    UserAgent matches regex @"(?i)sqlmap/|Fuzz Faster U Fool|Nmap Scripting Engine|\(Hydra\)|nuclei|dalfox|HeadlessChrome", "UA outil ARTEX",
    "")
| where isnotempty(Category)
| summarize Requetes = count() by Category
| order by Requetes desc
content.title: Requetes suspectes par categorie

content.query:
ArtexWebRequests
| where SrcIp !in (ArtexAllowlist)
| extend Category = case(
    UserAgent startswith "ARTEX-Assessment/", "UA ARTEX-Assessment",
    Target matches regex @"(?i)sess_[a-z0-9,-]{6,}", "php2shell",
    Target matches regex @"(?i)(\.\./){3,}|/etc/passwd|php://(filter|input)|data://text/plain|expect://", "LFI",
    Target matches regex @"(?i)union(\s|\+)+(all(\s|\+)+)?select|sleep\(\d+\)|waitfor(\s|\+)+delay|extractvalue\(|updatexml\(", "SQLi",
    Target matches regex @"(?i)<script|onerror\s*=|javascript:alert|<svg", "XSS",
    UserAgent matches regex @"(?i)sqlmap/|Fuzz Faster U Fool|Nmap Scripting Engine|\(Hydra\)|nuclei|dalfox|HeadlessChrome", "UA outil ARTEX",
    "")
| where isnotempty(Category)
| summarize Requetes = count(), Categories = make_set(Category), Reussites200 = countif(Status == 200), Hotes = make_set(Host, 10), Debut = min(TimeGenerated), Fin = max(TimeGenerated) by SrcIp
| order by array_length(Categories) desc, Requetes desc
| take 50
content.title: IP sources les plus actives (cliquer une ligne pour filtrer les URL)

content.query:
ArtexWebRequests
| where '{SelectedIp}' == '*' or SrcIp == '{SelectedIp}'
| where SrcIp !in (ArtexAllowlist)
| extend Category = case(
    UserAgent startswith "ARTEX-Assessment/", "UA ARTEX-Assessment",
    Target matches regex @"(?i)sess_[a-z0-9,-]{6,}", "php2shell",
    Target matches regex @"(?i)(\.\./){3,}|/etc/passwd|php://(filter|input)|data://text/plain|expect://", "LFI",
    Target matches regex @"(?i)union(\s|\+)+(all(\s|\+)+)?select|sleep\(\d+\)|waitfor(\s|\+)+delay|extractvalue\(|updatexml\(", "SQLi",
    Target matches regex @"(?i)<script|onerror\s*=|javascript:alert|<svg", "XSS",
    UserAgent matches regex @"(?i)sqlmap/|Fuzz Faster U Fool|Nmap Scripting Engine|\(Hydra\)|nuclei|dalfox|HeadlessChrome", "UA outil ARTEX",
    "")
| where isnotempty(Category)
| project TimeGenerated, SrcIp, LogSource, Host, Method, Url, Status, UserAgent, Category
| order by TimeGenerated desc
| take 200
content.title: Echantillon de requetes (IP selectionnee)

content.query:
SecurityIncident
| where Title has "ARTEX" or Title has "php2shell" or Title has "OAST" or Title has "Suricata ARTEX"
| summarize arg_max(LastModifiedTime, *) by IncidentNumber
| project IncidentNumber, Title, Severity, Status, Owner = tostring(Owner.assignedTo), CreatedTime
| order by CreatedTime desc
content.title: Incidents ARTEX
